summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react 18.0.3 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This Jest preset package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release archive, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line `math_init.js` that is heavily obfuscated with string-array shuffle techniques (rotation function, hex-style identifiers, giant `fromCodePoint` array; `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). A Jest configuration preset has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime, and the package's own `main` (`jest-preset.js`) does not reference Bun or `math_init.js`. The alternate-runtime dropper is used to execute obfuscated code the installer never opted into, at install time, outside the Node-only scanning surface. Package name, scope, and README present a benign Jest preset while the shipped preinstall performs unrelated code execution on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
